## Checklist

- [ ] I have read `POLICY.md`.
- [ ] I own the content or have permission to publish it.
- [ ] There is no student data, PII, exam answer or staff-only material.
- [ ] I ran `python3 scripts/validate_pack.py`.
- [ ] The exercises run and their failure messages are useful.
- [ ] I have declared a licence.
